prompt_md: A token starts on square 5 of a track numbered 0 to 10. Each turn a coin flip moves it one square left or right. On average, how many turns until it hits 0 or 10?
prompt_short: Random walk from 5 on a 0-10 track. Average turns to an end?
hint_md: Try a short track first: start on 1 of a track from 0 to 2.
explain_intuition_md: It's only 5 squares to either end, so 5 turns feels right. But a random walk wastes most of its moves going back and forth. Its typical distance from the start grows like the square root of the number of moves, so getting 5 squares away takes about 5 times 5 turns.
explain_math_md: From square $k$, $E_k = k(10-k)$ solves $E_k = 1 + \tfrac12E_{k-1} + \tfrac12E_{k+1}$ with $E_0 = E_{10} = 0$, so $E_5 = 25$.
